changes: Added a bounded repository hygiene workflow.
Manual hygiene sweep deletes only non-main branch refs whose tip is proven fully contained in canonical main by GitHub compare ancestry.
Branches with unique or divergent history are preserved for explicit audit.
Same-repository PR head branches are automatically deleted after a successful merge.
RUNBOOK documents the hygiene safety contract.
Control contract tests verify main protection, same-repository merged-PR guard, ancestry proof, and deleteRef usage.
